messages.author: 04731006f5b50bdb
messages.subject: buffer units
parts:
Hi Filipe,
I'd like to use the buffer= argument with fieldInfo and fieldArea to avoid plot edge effects but am not clear on the units/scaling involved. The documentation states "negative values should be used to remove boundaries from neighbor plot (normally the unit is meters, please use values as 0.1 = 10 cm)."  There's no real distance or area information in my mosaic, so what is the practical interpretation of the buffer units?  

Thank you,
Anna

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: buffer units
parts:
Hi Anna,

Thanks for asking us... The buffer unit is the raster unit. 

A good way to discover it is by using the function  res(your_raster) or projection(your_raster)

If it is not in "m", "cm", "feet", etc. you will need to put some thought into it to choose a value that makes sense for your image based on the number of pixels. If you see the resolution is 20 x 20 in a cellphone image for example with good quality you may use something like 100 and check the results.

Hope it helps...!

All the best,
Filipe
